run_multinode_deit_training: run multinode DeiT training on a SLURM cluster using submitit with configurable GPUs and nodes
submit_trainer_job: submit a Trainer job to a submitit AutoExecutor with GPU and node parameters
create_trainer_checkpoint: create a checkpoint for the Trainer class to resume training from a saved checkpoint file
setup_gpu_args: setup GPU arguments for a Trainer using submitit JobEnvironment to set rank and world size
get_init_file: get a unique initialization file path for distributed training using UUID and a shared folder
